source_path_base: Paths in source fields are relative to the voice-agent repository root. ../docs is external evaluation evidence and is not bundled with this template.
definition_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 of json.dumps(definition, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True). This is a semantic JSON fingerprint, not the raw file SHA256.

provenance.source_form: Portable authored {name, description, definition} document; exact candidate/agent.json bytes, not candidate/definition.json.
provenance.binding_policy: The source already has only empty server_url placeholders. They are retained byte-for-byte; the publisher supplies deployment bindings. No Project, test Agent name, URL, or credential was copied from the materialized evidence.

authored_structure.change: The source adds message_offer and waiting/refusal/ending routes. This is an actual business-graph change, not transfer-message shortening.

candidate_status.assessment_scope: Five complete candidate-08 functional conversations. The new formal latency plan was not started after blocking functional failures.
remaining_failures: An alternate identify_to_message route still permits message collection without the caller accepting the offer.
The spoken support flow did not explain the actual search failure.
Duplicate collection/confirmation and unnecessary waiting remain despite observed confirmed saves and native endings.
candidate_status.external_dependency: Trusted execution must protect every collection entrance and validate confirmation at the message-write boundary. Prompt rules and model-supplied confirmation flags are not authorization.
unassessed: Candidate-08 formal paired latency and no-added-wait acceptance.
Acoustic listening, physical speaker latency/overlap, exact substantive-word onset, and same-condition ElevenLabs comparison.
